evals.prompt: Write unit tests for onlineshopapi/src/main/java/msg/onlineshopapi/service/strategy/MostAbundantStrategy.java. Follow the existing strategy test style and use JUnit 5, Mockito, and AssertJ. Cover success, insufficient stock, missing stock, and multiple products. Do not change production code if a test exposes a bug.
evals.expected_output: A focused MostAbundantStrategyTest.java with one test per meaningful scenario, private fixture helpers, repository interaction assertions, and an explicit report of any failing bug-revealing test.
expectations: Uses JUnit 5 with MockitoExtension, Mock/InjectMocks where appropriate, and AssertJ assertions.
Contains separate tests for success, insufficient quantity, no stock, and multiple-product behavior.
Uses private helper methods for repeated Product, Location, Stock, or OrderDetail setup.
Does not modify production code to hide a failing test.

evals.prompt: Generate unit tests for the Spring Boot service method I provide, including normal behavior, empty input, boundary quantities, collaborator failures, and domain exceptions. First list the scenarios, then write one JUnit 5 test per scenario using Mockito and AssertJ. Inspect nearby tests and preserve their naming convention. If the implementation appears buggy, keep the failing test and tell me why it fails.
evals.expected_output: Tests for the supplied service method with a scenario list, local convention matching, private fixture helpers, broad edge-case coverage, and clear separation between passing tests and intentionally failing defect tests.
expectations: Covers success, boundaries, empty or invalid inputs, collaborator failure, and relevant exceptions when applicable.
Uses one focused test per scenario and private helpers for repeated setup.
Reports suspected defects without changing production code.

evals.prompt: Add unit tests for an entire Spring Boot service class with several public methods. Use pure Mockito-based unit tests rather than loading the application context unless required by the existing project. Aim for at least 80% meaningful coverage, prioritize edge cases, run the smallest relevant Maven test command, and report coverage limitations honestly.
evals.expected_output: A maintainable test class or set of test classes covering the service's public behavior and edge cases, with Mockito/AssertJ, private helpers, validation results, and honest coverage evidence.
expectations: Tests public behavior across the service methods rather than private implementation details.
Avoids unnecessary Spring context or integration dependencies.
Runs an appropriate targeted Maven test command and reports its result.
Does not claim 80% coverage without measurement or explain why measurement was unavailable.
